caption: The drawing depicts two objects: a knife and its sheath, both arranged diagonally against a plain, beige background. The knife is positioned at the lower right, with a metallic, double-edged blade that has a gradient of gray and hints of blue along the cutting edges. The blade is attached to a handle that is brown with a textured, bark-like pattern, featuring slight reddish undertones, and is fitted with a simple, flat, brass or gold-colored guard. Above the knife, the sheath is shown, also on a diagonal axis. The sheath has a predominantly dark brown body with traces of decorative gold or yellowish patterns and accents, and metallic fittings at both the tip and the top, which are brass or gold in color. The objects are placed apart with the sheath above and to the left of the knife. The artist’s signature “MICHAEL SIEROKI” appears in small text at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Dagger and Sheath
